destinations.title: Does aligned natural inflation compatible with the multi-axion weak gravity conjecture generically acquire subleading potential modulations, and what oscillations and observational constraints follow?

Can an axion/three-form system generate sufficiently fine Higgs-mass and MSSM soft-term landscapes, and what conditional restrictions follow from membrane nucleation and the membrane weak gravity conjecture?

Can extra-dimensional gauge symmetry protect high-scale axionic inflation coupled to supergravity while allowing supersymmetry near the electroweak scale today, and can additional multiplet fields produce observable primordial signatures?

How do fermions modify the 3-form description of instantons, can quantum-gravity expectations constrain axion-potential amplitudes and symmetry-breaking fermion operators, and can gravitational instantons generate analogous interactions?

Can a large-N Yang–Mills-inspired axion potential produce both primordial inflation and late-time quintessence with unchanged parameters, while satisfying the paper's historical CMB constraints and proposed scalar weak-gravity criteria?

What physically happens when an axion potential loses exponential suppression of its Fourier harmonics, and can spectral data replace instanton actions in describing this limit and the axionic Weak Gravity Conjecture?
Which proposed resolutions of axion quality, large-field inflation and monodromy backreaction survive quantum gravity, and what precise axion Weak Gravity Conjecture bounds are justified?

What controls the validity and ultimate UV cutoff of N = 1 axiverse EFTs, and under what conditions are fundamental-instanton and gravitational-wormhole contributions to axion symmetry breaking suppressed?

Can spatially separated charged fields generate exponentially protected four-dimensional global symmetries and an open string axiverse whose symmetry breaking permits post-inflationary axion cosmology?

Determine the continuous invertible and densely rational non-invertible symmetries of four-dimensional axiverse EFTs, their symmetry-breaking hierarchies, and the implications of the proposed Imaginary Distance Bound (IDB) for quantum-gravitational instanton corrections.
